question: In a velocity-time graph, the negative slope represents _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __Retardation.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a velocity-time graph__, the slope of the line indicates the acceleration or deceleration of an object.
 
• A negative slope means the object is experiencing retardation (negative acceleration).
 
• Retardation occurs when the velocity of the object is decreasing over time.
 
• It is represented by a downward-sloping line on the velocity-time graph.
 
• This concept is critical in understanding the motion of objects and is widely used in physics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Acceleration:**

 
 
• Acceleration refers to the rate of change of velocity of an object with time.
 
• It is represented by a positive slope on a velocity-time graph.
 
 
 
• **Displacement:**
 
 
• Displacement is the shortest distance from the initial to the final position of an object.
 
• It is a vector quantity and includes direction.
 
 
 
• **Distance:**
 
 
• Distance is the total path covered by an object irrespective of direction.
 
• It is a scalar quantity and does not include direction.
